title: Corrected-Refiling Handling Charge — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Fee Disclosure
content:
A corrected refiling of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate carries a corrected-refiling handling charge set by the endorsement fee of the coverage package on which the certified Cardinal Personal Auto Policy is written.

| Package endorsement fee | Corrected-refiling handling charge |
|---|---|
| 15.00 or more | 6.00 |
| Above zero but below 15.00 | 3.00 |
| Zero | None |

**Both sides of each limit (hypothetical package fees).**
- Endorsement fee 15.00: 6.00. Endorsement fee 14.99: 3.00.
- Endorsement fee 0.01: 3.00. Endorsement fee 0.00: none.

The endorsement fee read is the one set for the certified policy's package, not a fee charged on any particular endorsement.
